# Offline ESPN fixtures

These are synthetic, minimal league payloads modeled on the structures consumed
by the community code linked in `docs/espn-api-notes.md`. They are not captures
from a real league and do not establish that authenticated requests work.

IDs, names, and rosters are invented. There are no member identities, ownership
records, cookies, or private league data. Add real captures only after local
sanitization and record their provenance here.
